description: This file defines classes and methods for formatting and reporting step definitions in the 'behave' BDD testing framework. It includes classes for overview, documentation, usage, and catalog formatting of step definitions, as well as utility functions for handling steps.

classes.name: AbstractStepsFormatter
classes.description: Base class providing common functionality for formatters that operate on step definitions.

classes.name: StepsFormatter
classes.description: Provides an overview of available step definitions, grouped by step type.

classes.name: StepsDocFormatter
classes.description: Shows documentation for all registered step definitions, aiding test writers.

classes.name: StepsCatalogFormatter
classes.description: Displays non-technical, feature-file style list of step definitions, sorted by step type.

classes.name: StepsUsageFormatter
classes.description: Shows how step definitions are used in steps, including used, unused, and undefined steps.

methods.name: describe_step_definition
methods.description: Returns a string describing a step definition, including its pattern and type.

methods.name: write_step_definition
methods.description: Outputs the documentation and details of a step definition.

methods.name: steps_contain
methods.description: Utility to check if a list of steps contains a specific step, considering location.
